body.title: Complete current-source scoped regression and story validation
body.summary: After all implementation tasks and native feedback corrections, run one canonical Node22 regression over all installer tests plus installation-home/build/scanner/coordinator consumers using a fixed enumerated selection. Perform independent post-run exact coverage, source/input/output fingerprints and positive command/resource closure audit on the same output without rebuilding. Record per-task checks, native evidence limitations and source identity; submit story BUILD validation only after required tasks pass. No unrelated backend sweep or per-task human approval.
acceptanceChecks: Every required LLD test subject maps to recorded task evidence; canonical current-source selection has no failures/incomplete/unexpected omissions.
Independent audit proves exact selected coverage, unchanged pinned inputs/outputs, all owned command admission/close/disposal pairs, no remaining actors/leases and strict positive cleanup.
Old275-test pass and Linux native proof remain historical; source changes after final run invalidate current regression until affected checks and final audit are repeated as justified.
All required native and regression gates are satisfied before story completion/final human BUILD approval; foundation/S4 and Windows remain separate gated work.
